provenance.expected_basis: spec 8.8 (#296): rat is a key type; a rat is reduced, so rat(1, 2), rat(2, 4) and 2 / 4 are one key; keys() is sorted by value; a later literal entry and the right operand of + replace an equal key's value, as for int keys (printed beside them); an object key compares its rat field by value.
